description: Real incident: Guest reports AC units 'on' but no air, confirms using the remotes correctly with settings. Root cause was mixed modes (one head on 'heat', others 'cool' + unit at 80F) on Apt 2 (Sunny). Auto-reply must use neutral language ('make sure using the remotes'), use live Kumo status, auto-set all 3 heads to consistent mode (auto/cool at 65), and tell guest what was found + what was fixed.
guestMessage: We have both of the remotes turned on and set to these settings, still no air coming from either unit all night

conversationHistory.body: Hi Jerome, we’re having some issues with the AC units. Both of them say that they’re on, but no air is being blown out.
Good morning, Kathryn, sorry you're having trouble with the AC. Please don't use the Nest thermostat—it doesn't control the AC. Use the heat pump remotes on the wall in each room instead.
We have both of the remotes turned on and set to these settings, still no air coming from either unit all night

Good morning, Kathryn, sorry the AC isn't coming on. Please don't use the Nest thermostat — it doesn't control the AC. Use the heat pump remotes on the wall in each room instead. Let me know the exact settings you're seeing and if there's still no air.

actionTaken.reason: mixed modes or wrong season mode for complaint

heatPumpInfo.suggestedResponseSnippet: The master bedroom is on heat, and the living room and small bedroom are on cool. All of the wall units (living room, master bedroom, and small bedroom) need to be on the same mode — either all heat or all cool. If one is on heat and another is on cool, they will not work. I checked the heat pumps for you (room ~79°F). I've set all 3 units to auto at 65°F now so it should cool down shortly. You can still adjust with the remotes on the wall in each room. Let me know in a few minutes if the air is moving and the temperature is improving!

notes: Exact follow-up from the Kathryn Booker incident (June 2026). Mixed-mode replies name rooms (odd-one-out first), state the same-mode rule, and do not mention Nest or the apartment number. Live HeatPumpTool auto-fix of mixed modes is required. ConversationHistory includes the earlier host 'don't use Nest / use remotes' message so anti-repetition still applies. Required: room names + same mode + I checked/set all/auto at 65/cool down + remotes on the wall.
